# Introduction

# Simulation of the random process

```{r random}
set.seed(2026)
n_sample <- 100
random_vec <- rnorm(n_sample, 0, 1)
```

# Visualisation(s) of the random process
```{r}
plot(density(random_vec), xlab = "x", ylab = "Density", main = "Density approximation of 100 samples drawn from N(0,1)")
```
